text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a police officer of the Hub.
source_text: You see a police officer of the Hub.

text: 你看到了一位哈勃城的警官。
source_text: 你看到了一位哈勃城的警官。

text: I wish I was stationed closer to my home.
source_text: I wish I was stationed closer to my home.

text: 我希望能分配到离家近一点的地方。
source_text: 我希望能分配到离家近一点的地方。

text: I wonder what happened to those caravans.
source_text: I wonder what happened to those caravans.

text: 我奇怪这些商队都发生了什么。
source_text: 我奇怪这些商队都发生了什么。

text: Move along.
source_text: Move along.

text: 继续。
source_text: 继续。

text: You'd better keep your weapons holstered, stranger.
source_text: You'd better keep your weapons holstered, stranger.

text: 你最好收好你的武器，陌生人。
source_text: 你最好收好你的武器，陌生人。

text: Keep your nose clean.
source_text: Keep your nose clean.

text: 安分点。
source_text: 安分点。

text: Do you have any commodities to declare?
source_text: Do you have any commodities to declare?

text: 你有什么贵重品需要申报？
source_text: 你有什么贵重品需要申报？

text: Don't be waving your weapon in my face.
source_text: Don't be waving your weapon in my face.

text: 别在我的面前挥舞你的武器。
source_text: 别在我的面前挥舞你的武器。

text: Put that away unless you want some jail time.
source_text: Put that away unless you want some jail time.

text: 把那个收起来，除非你想在监狱里呆一阵子。
source_text: 把那个收起来，除非你想在监狱里呆一阵子。

text: Are you aiming that at me?
source_text: Are you aiming that at me?

text: 你在用那个指着我吗？
source_text: 你在用那个指着我吗？

text: I've heard of you. Watch it.
source_text: I've heard of you. Watch it.

text: 我听说过你。看看这个。
source_text: 我听说过你。看看这个。

text: We'll be keeping an eye on you.
source_text: We'll be keeping an eye on you.

text: 我们会注意你的。
source_text: 我们会注意你的。

text: No fighting in our town, tough guy.
source_text: No fighting in our town, tough guy.

text: 我们镇不允许殴斗，暴徒。
source_text: 我们镇不允许殴斗，暴徒。

text: We don't like baby killers!
source_text: We don't like baby killers!

text: 我们不喜欢杀小孩儿的人！
source_text: 我们不喜欢杀小孩儿的人！

text: Lay a hand on a kid and we'll hunt you down.
source_text: Lay a hand on a kid and we'll hunt you down.

text: 敢动孩子们一根手指头，我们就会追捕你。
source_text: 敢动孩子们一根手指头，我们就会追捕你。

text: I hate people like you.
source_text: I hate people like you.

text: 我讨厌像你这样的人。
source_text: 我讨厌像你这样的人。

text: Don't call for help if you're in trouble.
source_text: Don't call for help if you're in trouble.

text: 遇上麻烦的时候别指望求救。
source_text: 遇上麻烦的时候别指望求救。

text: Hey, thanks for doing our work for us.
source_text: Hey, thanks for doing our work for us.

text: 嘿，谢谢你帮我们代劳了。
source_text: 嘿，谢谢你帮我们代劳了。

text: We don't allow kill'n here, even if it is justified.
source_text: We don't allow kill'n here, even if it is justified.

text: 即使有正当的理由，我们这里也不允许杀人。
source_text: 即使有正当的理由，我们这里也不允许杀人。

text: If you're the one that killed the Deathclaw . . . thank you.
source_text: If you're the one that killed the Deathclaw . . . thank you.

text: 如果你是那个杀了死亡爪的人……那么谢谢你。
source_text: 如果你是那个杀了死亡爪的人……那么谢谢你。

text: Keep your nose clean while you're in our city.
source_text: Keep your nose clean while you're in our city.

text: 在我们城市的时候安分点。
source_text: 在我们城市的时候安分点。

text: I would keep clear of Decker if I was you.
source_text: I would keep clear of Decker if I was you.

text: 如果我是你的话，就会和德克保持距离的。
source_text: 如果我是你的话，就会和德克保持距离的。

text: Enjoy your stay.
source_text: Enjoy your stay.

text: 住的愉快。
source_text: 住的愉快。

text: Welcome to the Hub!
source_text: Welcome to the Hub!

text: 欢迎来到哈勃城！
source_text: 欢迎来到哈勃城！

text: Greetings, stranger.
source_text: Greetings, stranger.

text: 你好啊，陌生人。
source_text: 你好啊，陌生人。

text: Visit the Maltese Falcon for refreshing drinks.
source_text: Visit the Maltese Falcon for refreshing drinks.

text: 到马耳他猎鹰酒吧去喝几杯提提神吧。
source_text: 到马耳他猎鹰酒吧去喝几杯提提神吧。

text: Follow the main road if you're looking for the market.
source_text: Follow the main road if you're looking for the market.

text: 顺着主干道走，就可以找到商场了。
source_text: 顺着主干道走，就可以找到商场了。

text: Keep moving.
source_text: Keep moving.

text: 继续前进。
source_text: 继续前进。

text: Move along. Move along.
source_text: Move along. Move along.

text: 继续。继续。
source_text: 继续。继续。

text: We're here to Prevent and Survey.
source_text: We're here to Prevent and Survey.

text: 我们在这儿是为了调查和预防。
source_text: 我们在这儿是为了调查和预防。

text: Keep that weapon under control while you're in our city.
source_text: Keep that weapon under control while you're in our city.

text: 在我们城里，管好你的武器。
source_text: 在我们城里，管好你的武器。

text: Don't you get into any fights with that.
source_text: Don't you get into any fights with that.

text: 别再挑事了。
source_text: 别再挑事了。

text: I'd recommend putting your weapon away.
source_text: I'd recommend putting your weapon away.

text: 我建议你把武器收起来。
source_text: 我建议你把武器收起来。

text: You should put that away . . . your weapon, that is.
source_text: You should put that away . . . your weapon, that is.

text: 你应该把那个收起来……你的武器，就那个。
source_text: 你应该把那个收起来……你的武器，就那个。

text: Welcome Paladin, it's been a while.
source_text: Welcome Paladin, it's been a while.

text: 欢迎，骑士，
source_text: 欢迎，骑士，

text: You're that rowdy one. No more fighting okay?
source_text: You're that rowdy one. No more fighting okay?

text: 你就是那无赖吧。别在打架了，知道吗？
source_text: 你就是那无赖吧。别在打架了，知道吗？

text: You better not start another fight!
source_text: You better not start another fight!

text: 你最好别再惹事了！
source_text: 你最好别再惹事了！

text: It's you . . . keep that temper of yours under control.
source_text: It's you . . . keep that temper of yours under control.

text: 是你……控制好你的脾气。
source_text: 是你……控制好你的脾气。

text: The Far Go Traders got wiped out. I can't believe it.
source_text: The Far Go Traders got wiped out. I can't believe it.

text: 远行商队居然出事了。我简直不能相信。
source_text: 远行商队居然出事了。我简直不能相信。

text: The Water Merchants are gone. What a relief.
source_text: The Water Merchants are gone. What a relief.

text: 净水商人已经不存在了。真是帮大忙了。
source_text: 净水商人已经不存在了。真是帮大忙了。

text: The Crimson Caravan has been destroyed.
source_text: The Crimson Caravan has been destroyed.

text: 深红商队已经被毁灭了。
source_text: 深红商队已经被毁灭了。

text: Did you hear? The Underground has finally been wiped out!
source_text: Did you hear? The Underground has finally been wiped out!

text: 你听说了吗？那些暗杀者被人除去了！
source_text: 你听说了吗？那些暗杀者被人除去了！

text: Decker's dead!
source_text: Decker's dead!

text: 德克死了！
source_text: 德克死了！

text: The Decker problem has finally been solved.
source_text: The Decker problem has finally been solved.

text: 德克这问题终于被解决了。
source_text: 德克这问题终于被解决了。

text: Watch your back -- this isn't a safe place.
source_text: Watch your back -- this isn't a safe place.

text: 看看你的后面——这里可不是个安全的地方。
source_text: 看看你的后面——这里可不是个安全的地方。

text: Watch your scripts, guy.
source_text: Watch your scripts, guy.

text: 注意你的举止，朋友。
source_text: 注意你的举止，朋友。

text: Watch your scripts, lady.
source_text: Watch your scripts, lady.

text: 注意你的举止，女士。
source_text: 注意你的举止，女士。

text: Old Harold's good for telling tales.
source_text: Old Harold's good for telling tales.

text: 老哈罗德特别善于讲故事。
source_text: 老哈罗德特别善于讲故事。

text: You shouldn't be here, it's not safe.
source_text: You shouldn't be here, it's not safe.

text: 你不应该来这儿的，不安全。
source_text: 你不应该来这儿的，不安全。

text: Old Town's really fallen apart.
source_text: Old Town's really fallen apart.

text: 老镇真的是已经支离破碎了。
source_text: 老镇真的是已经支离破碎了。

text: This place smells.
source_text: This place smells.

text: 这地方真难闻。
source_text: 这地方真难闻。

text: We should tear this whole area down.
source_text: We should tear this whole area down.

text: 我们应该拆毁这里整个区域。
source_text: 我们应该拆毁这里整个区域。

text: I know that damn thieves circle is around here somewhere.

text: 我知道那些见鬼的盗贼工会就在这里的某个地方。
source_text: 我知道那些见鬼的盗贼工会就在这里的某个地方。

text: Poor Harold -- he's had a rough life.
source_text: Poor Harold -- he's had a rough life.

text: 可怜的哈罗德——他这辈子过的都很难。

text: Keep your nose clean.
source_text: Keep your nose clean.

text: 安分点。

source_text: Hey.  I know you.  No more fighting, okay?

source_text: 嘿。我知道你。别再动拳头了，明白？

source_text: You'd better not be thinking of starting another fight!

text: If we catch you fighting again, you're going in!

text: 德克死了！
